recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It aligns the remaining build-facing descriptions for :iterate without taking on the separate unresolved FHIR-54054 example issue.
issue_request: FHIR-46944 asked to clarify the :iterate modifier wording on FHIR-core-search so inclusion directives are described as applying to included resources as well, rather than only matching resources. The Jira issue is Applied/Persuasive, voted 10-0-0, and applied for R6.
initial_application: Commit 80761a68de394a4770496d0f05bfd4494abc0e98, merged via HL7/fhir#3442, updated the detailed Modifier: iterate paragraph in source/search.html. The search modifier summary table and source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml were not updated and still carried the obsolete wording.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2025-01-13 confirm the persuasive vote. Earlier applied/published issues FHIR-31939 and FHIR-46101 shape nearby _include:iterate guidance and performance text but do not conflict with this clarification. Later FHIR-54054 is Triaged and concerns a separate example typo, so it was not included in this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html's search modifier summary table and the SearchModifierCode CodeSystem iterate definition to use the same approved wording already present in the detailed Modifier: iterate section.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the search modifier summary table definition for iterate to say inclusion directives should be applied to included resources as well, rather than only matching resources.
source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml: changed the iterate concept definition in SearchModifierCode to the same clarified wording.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published search-page clarification that _include and _revinclude normally apply to initial results and :iterate repeats them on included resources.
Applied issue that added performance guidance to the same modifier section without changing the FHIR-46944 rule.
Later Triaged issue about a separate _include:iterate example typo; not a final decision and not part of this fix.
